snv.clade-score-help: How cleanly a site's alt calls follow the clade it maps to: F1 of 'alt call' vs 'in the mapped clade' over cells with a genotype call, 2·alt in clade / (2·alt in clade + ref in clade + alt outside). 1 = every called cell in the clade is alt and no called cell outside it is.

cohort.empty: No single-cell patients in this dataset. Patients are datafiles.json entries with entry_type "patient".
cohort.heatmap-title: Total copy number across the cohort
cohort.tmb-help: Tree-mapped SNV sites used to build each patient's tree: truncal = mapped to the tumor MRCA, subclonal = an internal node below it, private = one cell. 'Per Mb' divides by an approximate callable territory (median breadth of the tumor cells × 3,100 Mb); patients without breadth QC show n/a.
cohort.tmb-empty: No tree-mapped SNV sites loaded yet.
cohort.signatures-help: SigProfilerAssignment fits (COSMIC v3.4) from each patient's signatures.json; hover a segment for the aetiology.
cohort.oncoprint-help: Each cell is the strongest alteration of that gene in that patient, shaded by the fraction of tumor cells carrying it (label). Several alteration classes stack as stripes. Bars on top count altered genes per patient; the right column counts patients per gene. Click to open the patient.
cohort.scatter-help: One point per patient. Click a point to open the patient.
cohort.genes-note: one bar per patient, stacked by alteration class

toolbar.clip-help: Branches longer than 3× the 95th percentile (e.g. a normal outgroup) are drawn shortened and marked with //

palette.title: Copy-number colours
palette.note: Saved in this browser. The last colour is used for that state and above.
palette.theme-help: Colours for clones, groups, UMAP fields, violins, signatures and saved groups. The heatmap copy-number colours are set separately below.

events.summary: {{snvs}} SNV sites · {{genes}} copy-number / fusion events · {{cells}} cells carrying them
events.help: Tick events below to show them on the Single-Cell heatmap: SNVs filter the SNV heatmap to those sites, copy-number changes and fusions zoom the CN heatmap to their genes, and the cells carrying them are selected.
events.strong-help: Hide likely noise: deletions must be in at least 10% of tumor cells, other events in at least 3 cells and 5% of tumor cells. Turn off to see every event.
events.show-on-tree: Show {{count}} as strips on the tree
events.clade-score-help: How well the carrier cells follow the phylogeny: best F1 between the carriers and any clade of the tree. 1 = exactly one clade; low values mean scattered cells, typical of noisy junction or deletion calls.
events.clade-score-detail: {{inClade}} of the {{carriers}} carriers sit in the best clade of {{clade}} cells

dosage.title: Dosage vs expression
dosage.summary: {{gene}}: {{n}} cells with DNA and RNA · Spearman ρ {{rho}} · slope {{slope}} log-expression per copy
dosage.no-gene: {{gene}} is not in both the RNA matrix and the gene annotation
dosage.rank-intro: Rank all genes by the correlation between copy number at their locus and their expression (cells with both DNA and RNA).
dosage.rank-help: {{count}} genes expressed in at least 10 cells; click a gene to plot it
dosage.by-chromosome-help: Share of ranked genes on each chromosome whose expression follows copy number (Spearman ρ ≥ 0.3); red when the chromosome's median ρ is ≥ 0.3.
dosage.help: One panel per gene; click a point to select the cell, drag a box to select cells (Shift adds). Selection is shared with the tree below, the heatmap and the UMAP.

signatures.title: SBS signatures
signatures.backend-help: CellPhy-input sites: all, by where they map on the tree, and sites with alt reads in each clone.
signatures.src-filtered: Sites shown in the SNV heatmap
signatures.need-selection: Select cells in the tree or heatmap first
signatures.filter-note: Uses the SNV heatmap's site filter: {{filter}}
signatures.no-filter-note: Uses every SNV site; filter sites in the SNV heatmap toolbar to narrow the set.
signatures.no-contexts: This patient's SNV matrix has no trinucleotide contexts; rerun the signatures step of gos_sc_upload.R.
signatures.fit-summary: {{n}} sites · NNLS with stepwise selection on COSMIC v3.4 GRCh38 · cosine similarity {{cosine}} (bars: observed, dots: fitted)
signatures.catalog-title: Mutation catalog of the fitted sites ({{n}} SNVs)
signatures.catalog-help: Catalog: observed SBS96 counts, with the fitted reconstruction as the reference outline. Decomposed: each fitted signature's share of every channel, against its COSMIC v3.4 profile scaled to its activity (as in the bulk Signatures tab).
signatures.sets-help: Pick a site set and run the browser fit, or choose a set with a precomputed SigProfilerAssignment fit (all / truncal / subclonal / private / clones).
signatures.ci-note: 95% bootstrap intervals from 100 resamples of the sites
signatures.fit-missing: Fit {{count}} sets without a backend fit
signatures.compare-help: Backend SigProfilerAssignment fits where available; sets marked * were fitted here (NNLS on this patient's signatures). Clone sets are the tree sites with alt reads in the clone's cells.
signatures.compare-empty: No fits yet: click the fit button to fit the sets in the browser.
signatures.similarity-help: SBS96 profiles compared directly (sets with at least 10 sites). Low similarity between truncal and subclonal sites or between clones points to a change in mutational process.
signatures.tree-help: Each clade's bar is the NNLS fit of the SBS96 profile of the tree sites with alt reads in its cells, using the signatures SigProfiler found for this patient. The right column is the cosine similarity of the clade's profile to the truncal profile (red below 0.8). Click a clade to select its cells.
signatures.clade-vs-rest-meta: {{nClade}} sites in the clade, {{nRest}} outside · cosine between profiles {{cos}}
signatures.clade-vs-rest-help: NNLS shares of the signatures found for this patient, with 95% bootstrap intervals (80 resamples of sites). * = intervals do not overlap.

umap.not-in-tree: no DNA cell in the tree
umap.hint: Hover to find a cell in the tree · click to select · ⌘/Ctrl-click to toggle · drag to lasso (Shift adds)
umap.view-dna-umap: Cells with DNA (UMAP rerun on them)

igv.sync: Zoom genome views to this site

rna.de-summary: {{a}} ({{nA}}) vs {{b}} ({{nB}}): {{tested}} genes tested, {{sig}} with p < {{p}}, q < {{q}} and |log2FC| ≥ {{lfc}}. These cutoffs also set the genes used for enrichment and the DE heatmap on the tree. p adj = Bonferroni (as Seurat); q = Benjamini-Hochberg.
rna.exploratory: A group has fewer than 20 cells: treat these results as exploratory. Cells within one patient are not independent replicates.
rna.enrich-summary: {{set}}: {{n}} selected genes in a universe of {{universe}} tested genes; {{sig}} sets with q < 0.05 (hypergeometric).

rna.multi-small: {{count}} groups with fewer than 3 RNA cells left out
rna.multi-markers: Top markers per group (each vs rest)

rna.add-set: Add a gene set (with module score)

branch.help: Sites whose mutation maps to this branch: gained here and carried by the cells below it. Click a site to view the reads in IGV.
branch.igv: Open the reads of cells in this clade in IGV
branch.show-in-heatmap: Show these sites in the heatmap

event-cells.title: Cells carrying the event · {{location}}
event-cells.no-cells: No cells are listed for this event.

qc.title: Cell QC
qc.empty: No QC metrics are available for these cells.
qc.help: FGA is the fraction of the genome whose copy number differs from the cell's rounded ploidy. Library metrics come from the pipeline export (not every patient has all of them); RNA QC from the Seurat metadata of linked cells. Red points are more than 3 MADs from the patient median.
qc.cohort-help: {{count}} cells flagged as outliers (> 3 MADs from their patient's median). Click a point to open that cell.

bars.title: Bar annotations on the phylogeny
bars.rna-cn-title: Copy number and expression on the phylogeny
bars.help: Bars follow the tree rows. Per clone / clade: numeric tracks show the mean over the group's cells and signatures are fitted on the group's pooled SNV sites (NNLS on the signatures found for this patient). Click a bar or clade to select its cells; Cmd/Ctrl-click adds.

report.title: Key findings · {{patient}}
report.summary-cells: {{tumor}} tumor cells and {{normal}} normal cells in {{clones}} clones.
report.summary-no-clonal: No tier 1–2 alteration is present in nearly all tumor cells.
report.summary-subclonal: {{count}} subclonal driver alterations mark subsets of cells.
report.clonal-help: Tier 1–2 alterations in at least {{pct}} of tumor cells: most likely acquired on the trunk.
report.subclonal-help: Tier 1–2 alterations in 10–85% of tumor cells, with the clones that carry them.
report.rare: {{count}} further tier 1–2 alterations in fewer than 10% of cells (shown with the strong-events filter off): {{list}}.
report.clone-no-defining: No tier 1–2 alteration is specific to this clone.
report.burden-title: SNV burden by tree position (CellPhy-input sites)
report.unverified-help: Fusions come from per-cell genome-graph walks and have not been checked against reads.
report.zoom: Zoom the single-cell heatmap to this locus
report.igv: View reads of carrier cells in IGV
report.show-site: Show only this SNV site in the mutation heatmap
report.caveat-fusions-unverified: Fusion calls are unverified gGnome walks; check them in IGV before trusting them.
report.caveat-homdel-noise: Many homozygous-deletion calls are present in only 1–2 cells and are likely coverage dropout; they are hidden here.
report.clone-fisher: Fisher's exact test, carriers in this clone vs other tumor cells: {{p}}, odds ratio {{or}}. * = enriched (p < 0.01, > 50% of the clone).
report.matrix-click: Click the name to select the carrier cells
report.matrix-help: Rows: tier 1–2 alterations ordered from the trunk down (by the tree depth of the clade their carriers fit best); right column: fraction of tumor cells · clade fit (red when carriers are scattered, i.e. likely noise). Columns: cells in tree order under their clone colour. Click a cell or a row name to select; hover to highlight across views.
report.igv-fusion: View reads at the first breakpoint of the fusion in carrier cells (verify the call)
report.findings-sigs-clone: {{n}} post-trunk sites · top {{top}} ({{share}}) · cosine to truncal {{cos}}.
report.findings-sigs-few: only {{n}} post-trunk sites (too few to fit).
report.findings-rna-test: Composition of {{field}} differs between clones: chi-square {{p}}.
report.findings-dosage-row: {{kind}}: Spearman ρ {{rho}} between copy number and expression; mean log-expression {{inside}} in {{nIn}} carriers vs {{outside}} in {{nOut}} other cells.
report.findings-dosage-help: Cells with both DNA and RNA; ρ across all cells, means split by carrier status.

site.carriers-of: {{carriers}} cells with alt reads of {{covered}} covered

circos.title: Circos of a cell
circos.help: Outer ring: chromosomes. Inner ring: total copy number of the cell's genome graph (heatmap palette, height ∝ CN up to 8). Arcs: ALT junctions between breakpoints.
circos.select-cell: Select this cell in the heatmap
circos.min-share: Junction in ≥ fraction of clone cells
circos.tree-help: Click cells or clades to choose the rings (up to 6).
circos.help2: Rings from the outside in: chromosomes (ticks every 50 Mb), then one copy-number ring per cell or clone (height ∝ CN up to 6; dashed line = CN 2; heatmap palette). Clone rings are the median CN of the clone's cells and show junctions found in at least the chosen fraction of its cells (line width ∝ recurrence).
